methods.name: getViewer
methods.description: Returns active WebGL particle viewer when available.

methods.name: addForce
methods.description: Registers an external force descriptor on the component instance.

methods.name: beforeCreate
methods.description: Legacy local arrays kept for optional non-WebGL/debug paths.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Legacy update hook for non-WebGL/debug paths.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Legacy render hook for non-WebGL/debug paths.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Seeds local fallback arrays; active WebGL simulation uses engine-side buffers.

methods.name: getRenderSize
methods.description: Computes render size from explicit params or host element metrics.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Resizes canvas and syncs projection uniforms/matrices.

methods.name: setParticleCount
methods.description: Recreates the particle engine with a new max particle count.

methods.name: setMask
methods.description: Loads and applies a mask to the active WebGL particle stage.

methods.name: setMaskSettings
methods.description: Updates mask placement settings and reapplies the active mask when possible.

methods.name: loadMask
methods.description: Loads a mask image to the WebGL particle system.

methods.name: applyMask
methods.description: Applies a preloaded mask index to active particles.

methods.name: clearMask
methods.description: Clears active mask influence and rebuilds random particle seed.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a runtime particle property (supports vector index notation).

methods.name: setParticleColor
methods.description: Sets a single default particle color for active particles and future rebuilds.

methods.name: setMotion
methods.description: Applies motion multipliers to particle simulation.

methods.name: setCameraPan
methods.description: Sets fake camera pan in world units.

methods.name: moveCameraPan
methods.description: Adds fake camera pan movement in world units.

methods.name: setCameraDepthEffect
methods.description: Sets fake camera depth parallax strength.

methods.name: addEmitter
methods.description: Adds or replaces the active WebGL emitter adapter.

methods.name: removeEmitter
methods.description: Removes the active WebGL emitter adapter.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Scatters particles from a center point.

methods.name: jitter
methods.description: Applies random positional jitter to active particles.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a named snapshot of particle state.

methods.name: restoreSnapshot
methods.description: Restores a named snapshot of particle state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets particle state to a snapshot.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts simulation if viewer is initialized.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops simulation if viewer is initialized.

methods.name: applyMotionConfig
methods.description: Applies motion scale multipliers to the active engine instance.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnect lifecycle: stop renderer and clean observers/listeners.

methods.name: onPropertyChanged
methods.description: Property change hook (reserved for future width/height/reactive behavior).

methods.name: onAttributeChanged
methods.description: Applies attribute-only aliases that are not component properties.
